title: Mapping and cleaning was not effective for my apartment
text: Mapping and cleaning was not effective for my apartment. Initially the robot vacuum was easy to setup and easy to use. I liked the style and ease of the remote control. Very simple to start it up and the vacuum would go back to its charger when it's done. However I would have to watch the vacuum when using it bc when I would leave it alone it would miss a lot of the surface area of the apartment. If it would hit a piece of a leg on a furniture, the area around the leg would not get cleaned. Then I would need to redo the vacuuming again with a standard vacuum bc there would still be dust and hair.
